## What

What this change does.

## Why

The problem it solves or the reason for it.

## Checklist

- [ ] `just check` passes
- [ ] `just generate` was run and the regenerated files are committed
- [ ] A new or changed token has a contrast pair in `tests/contrast-pairs.json`
- [ ] A new scale token carries a `$description` naming a measured usage
- [ ] Every commit carries a `Signed-off-by` trailer (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] No gate was weakened to pass
